connector.name: Lucairn MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: Pseudonymizes PII before your LLM and returns a cryptographically signed receipt per response.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the declade account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: LUCAIRN_API_KEY
env.description: Lucairn gateway API key (lcr_live_*). Issued at https://lucairn.eu/account/keys. Free tier requires BYOK upstream LLM keys (ANTHROPIC_API_KEY or OPENAI_API_KEY).

env.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
env.description: Upstream Anthropic API key. Used when the requested model is claude-* / anthropic-*. Required if you call Claude models on the free tier (BYOK).

env.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
env.description: Upstream OpenAI API key. Used when the requested model routes to OpenAI. Required if you call OpenAI models on the free tier (BYOK).

env.name: LUCAIRN_BASE_URL
env.description: Override the gateway URL. Defaults to https://gateway.lucairn.eu (production). Set this to point at a self-hosted Lucairn deployment.

env.name: LUCAIRN_TRANSPORT
env.description: Transport mode for the MCP server. One of 'direct-http' (default; v1.1+ behavior) or 'stdio-bridge' (v1.2+ opt-in).
